An
Ordinance further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette
of N.‑W.F.P., Extraordinary, 13th August, 2001]
No. 1egis. 1‑DE(BOR/22/2000/4132‑37,
dated 13‑8‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance by ,the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
North‑West Frontier Province Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It extends
to the whole of the North‑West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall
come into force at once.
